Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Awesome, we’re glad you’re here—let’s walk through it step by step.

Start a trial: When you sign up, we build a custom meal plan for your dog and send a 2-week trial. After that, it rolls into a recurring delivery every 4 weeks, which you can change or cancel anytime before the order deadline.
Set up your pup’s profile: You’ll share details like weight, goals, and activity level (Average, Active, or Athlete). This helps us calculate the right portion sizes.
Check portions & feeding guide: In your account’s Pets page, you can see each dog’s recipes, portions, and a Feeding Guide with up‑to‑date instructions on how much to serve.
Unpack your first box:
Carefully open the box and lift the liner flap.
If there’s dry ice, don’t touch it—let it disappear in a ventilated spot away from kids and pets.
Once it’s gone, move meals to the freezer, and put a couple in the fridge to start serving.
Transition slowly: To avoid tummy upset, mix Nom Nom with your dog’s current food:
Days 1–2: 25% Nom Nom / 75% old food
Days 3–4: 50% / 50%
Days 5–6: 75% Nom Nom / 25% old food
Day 7: 100% Nom Nom
Using as a topper: If you’re just adding Nom Nom on top, reduce the old food by about the same number of calories so you don’t overfeed.
Manage your subscription: In your account, you can update what’s in your order, delivery timing/address, and payment info. Orders renew automatically; charges appear in your order history.
Taking a break or resuming: If you’ve paused before, you can log in, pick a plan, review your pet’s details, then hit “Resume Subscription” to restart deliveries.
Cost & trying recipes first: Pricing depends on your dog’s details and chosen recipes. If you want to test flavors before committing, you can buy Variety Packs or single packs through Chewy, Amazon, or PetSmart and then come back to set up a personalized plan.

That’s the basic roadmap: sign up for the trial, fill out your dog’s profile, unpack and store meals safely, transition slowly, and manage everything from your account.

Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
Here’s a quick, simple rundown of your main options with us:
Start with a trial: Sign up, get a custom 2‑week trial, then it rolls into a recurring plan every 4 weeks (you can change or cancel before the order deadline).
Customize meals: On your Pets page you can change recipes, choose fixed or rotating recipes, pick full or half portions, and decide how many meal packs per day.
Control portions & feeding: Your dog’s portions and a detailed feeding guide are always shown in your account so you know exactly how much to serve.
Manage your account: In your account, you can adjust what’s in each order, delivery timing and address, and view payment info and order history.
Add treats & supplements: On the Extras page you can add treats and probiotics as a one‑time add‑on or in every box.
Add or remove dogs: You can add new dogs and build separate meal plans for them; removing a dog requires chatting with a Pet Support Specialist, and any change can affect your price.
Choose activity level: When building a profile, pick Average, Active, or Athlete so we can size portions based on how much your dog moves.
Try samples first: If you want to test things out, you can buy Variety Packs and single packs through partners like Chewy, Amazon, and PetSmart before starting a subscription.
Buy without a subscription: You can also buy our recipes, treats, and probiotics through retailers like Amazon, Chewy, and PetSmart if you don’t want a subscription.
If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.

For a first-timer like me, what's the safest, easiest choice?
Totally get wanting an easy, low-stress first step. For a first-timer, the safest, easiest choice is:
Start with our two-week trial subscription, where we create a meal plan based on your dog’s health goals.
Transition gradually over a week: begin with about 25% Nom Nom and 75% current food, and slowly increase the Nom Nom portion.
If you’re unsure what recipe they’ll like, you can first try a Variety Pack from Chewy or Amazon so your pup can taste-test before committing.
This combo keeps things gentle on your dog’s tummy while you figure out what they love most.
